name: Transamerica Pyramid
description: A very tall pale stone office tower shaped like a slender four-sided pyramid with a pointed spire. Dense horizontal rows of dark windows cover its tapering faces. Two narrow vertical fins project from opposite upper sides. Exposed triangular supports form a broad base, surrounded by much shorter city blocks and small trees.
